svg.title: G-3 mass budget, SLED75 with loader and tiller
svg.text: G-3 mass budget, SLED75 with loader and tiller
Line items, kg. Bar nominal, whisker low to high (cut at the axis end)
Shell: cylinder, rear dome, junction ring
Door leaf, double seal, dust cover
Bridge lip over the sill trough
Public lander classes, mass to the surface
Blue Moon MK1, 3 t: 6,150 kg over at nominal + 20%
CLPS target, 5 t: 4,150 kg over at nominal + 20%
CLPS target, 8 t: 1,150 kg over at nominal + 20%
Large cargo, 12 to 15 t: 5,850 kg spare at nominal + 20%
Allocations carried from G-2 are scaled by deck area, volume or mass carried; the inputs table lists each rule. High column stacks every high input at once, a corner case.
CLPS 5 t and 8 t are NASA growth targets, not hardware. 12 to 15 t is NASA's large cargo lander range. Envelopes are not public for any of them.
